integrity: The finite spectrum was independently classified by induced-set connectivity and by direct codeword support containment over all nonzero row sums. Public-source comparisons distinguish the incidence construction from adjacency-matrix graph codes.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the incidence code of the four-dimensional hypercube; no higher-dimensional formula is claimed. The total count 37293 is known, while the weight-resolved refinement is the asserted contribution.
title: Minimal-word weight spectrum of the \(4\)-cube incidence code
